title: phaseolus radiatus var. setulosus
intro: Phaseolus radiatus var. setulosus, commonly known as hairy kidney bean or hairy mung bean, is a plant species within the legume family. It is known to provide various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its high fiber and antioxidant content. The therapeutic actions of Phaseolus radiatus var. setulosus include its potential to lower blood pressure, improve digestion, and aid in weight management. The bioactive constituents of this plant include polyphenols, flavonoids, and isoflavones, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
